meta.description: NodiRetsept — get the prescription your doctor issued online, via QR code or ID.
meta.ogDescription: Get the prescription your doctor issued via QR code or ID and download it as a PDF.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Doctor and administrator workspace
auth.patientLink: Find your prescription by ID or QR code
auth.disabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact the administrator.

home.title: NodiRetsept — check your prescription online
home.heroLead: Enter the ID your doctor gave you or scan the QR code — your prescription opens instantly and can be downloaded as a PDF.
home.notFound: No prescription found for {id}. Check the ID and try again.
home.step1d: After your visit the doctor issues the prescription in the system and gives you an ID and a QR code.
home.step2t: You scan or type the ID
home.step2d: Scan the QR code with your phone camera or enter the ID in the field above.
home.step3d: The prescription opens on screen — save it as a PDF or print it.
home.step4d: Send the ID to the bot and the prescription PDF arrives right away.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.subtitle: Point your camera at the QR code on the prescription
scan.placeholder: Press the button to turn on the camera
scan.hint: Place the QR code inside the frame…
scan.noCameraText: Enter the prescription ID manually — it is printed under the QR code.
scan.httpsNote: Note: the camera only works over HTTPS or on localhost.
scan.errUnsupported: This browser does not support the camera. Please enter the ID manually.
scan.errDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings.
scan.errOpen: Could not open the camera. Please enter the ID manually.
scan.errNotOurs: This QR code is not a NodiRetsept prescription

notfound.title: Prescription not found
notfound.checkId: Check the ID — it looks like NR-XXXX-XXXX. If the problem persists, contact your doctor.
notfound.pageText: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

rx.title: PRESCRIPTION
rx.subtitle: Rx / Prescription
rx.cancelled: Warning! This prescription has been cancelled by the doctor. Please contact your doctor.

editor.subtitle: Select a patient and enter the treatment
editor.searchHint: If the patient is not on the list, use the “+ Add new patient” entry in the search results.
editor.newPatientHint: not found in the list — create a new record
editor.stampHint: To show your seal on the form, upload it in your profile or ask the administrator.
editor.footHint: Once saved, the prescription gets an ID and a QR code automatically
editor.readySub: Give the patient the QR code or the ID
editor.qrHint: The patient opens the prescription by scanning the QR code or entering this ID

dash.todayCount: You have written {n} prescriptions today. Press the button to write a new one — pick a patient and fill in the form.
dash.noRxText: Press the button above to write your first prescription.
dash.howText: Every prescription gets a QR code and an ID like NR-XXXX-XXXX. The patient scans the QR, types the ID on the site, or sends it to the Telegram bot.

patients.title: Patients
patients.subtitle: Pick a patient and write a prescription straight away
patients.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone or patient code…
patients.emptyFoundText: Try a different search or add a new patient.
patients.emptyListText: You can add a new patient right in the prescription window.
patients.noHistoryText: This patient has no prescriptions yet.

rxlist.title: Prescriptions
rxlist.subtitle: Search by ID, patient or diagnosis
rxlist.emptyText: Change the filter or write a new prescription.

profile.title: Profile
profile.personalHint: These details appear in the “Doctor” section of the prescription form.
profile.mediaHint: A PNG with a transparent background is recommended (max 3 MB). These images appear on the form and in the PDF.
profile.blankHint: The administrator configures the form. Contact them if it needs changing.
profile.pwdShort: The new password must be at least 6 characters.
profile.pwdMismatch: The new passwords do not match.

admin.title: Administrator panel
admin.doctorsSubtitle: Create accounts, manage forms and seals
admin.createHint: The doctor will sign in with this username and password.
admin.accountCreated: Once the account exists you can set up the seal, signature and personal form.
admin.noDoctorsText: Add the first doctor to the system.
admin.isActive: Account is active (otherwise the doctor cannot sign in)
admin.blankFallback: Fields left blank fall back to the shared form values.
admin.resetConfirm: The personal form will be deleted and the shared one used instead. Continue?
admin.viewFullBlank: To see the whole form, open any prescription by this doctor.
admin.stampHint: Appears on the form and in the PDF. A PNG with a transparent background is recommended (max 3 MB).
admin.signHint: The signature appears at the bottom of the form, above the signature line.
admin.passwordHint: Pass the new password to the doctor through a secure channel.
admin.setPasswordConfirm: Set a new password for this doctor?
admin.globalBlankSub: These settings apply to every doctor without a personal form
admin.blankStructureNote: The order follows international prescribing practice (WHO Guide to Good Prescribing).
admin.personalBlanksText: Each doctor can have their own form — clinic name, colour, visible sections.
admin.botEnvHint: Check TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_ENABLED=true in the .env file, then restart the server.
admin.botNoUsersText: Patients appear here once they send /start to the bot.
admin.botHow1: The patient sends /start to the bot
admin.botHow5: The bot sends the PDF file
admin.botMineNote: The My prescriptions button finds prescriptions by the patient's phone number — the phone must be filled in on the patient record.
admin.botDeepLinkText: A link that opens the prescription directly in the bot:
admin.sysConfigHint: These values are read from the project's .env file. Restart the server after changing them.
admin.publicUrlWarn: Important: QR codes point to PUBLIC_URL. When deploying, change it to your real domain, otherwise the QR codes will point at localhost.
admin.backupText: The whole database lives in a single file. To back it up, copy this file:
admin.backupHint: Stopping the server before copying is recommended (or copy the .db, .db-wal and .db-shm files together).
admin.uploadsText: Seals, signatures and logos are stored in data/uploads/. Copy it along with the database.
admin.blankSaved: The doctor's personal form has been saved.
admin.blankReset: Personal form deleted — the shared form is now used.

tpl.accentHint: Colour of the form rule, heading and the “Rx” symbol
tpl.footerNote: Note at the bottom of the form

js.needDrugOrPhysio: Add at least one medicine or physiotherapy.

instructions: in the morning on an empty stomach

bot.welcomeNew: Hello{name}! 👋 NodiRetsept lets you get the prescription your doctor issued, online. To begin, share your phone number with the button below 👇
bot.welcomeBack: Welcome back{name}! 👋 To get your prescription, tap 🔍 Find prescription and send the ID your doctor gave you.
bot.phoneOk: ✅ Thank you! Your number has been saved: {phone} You can now look up your prescription.
bot.needPhone: To use this service, please share your phone number first 👇
bot.askId: 🔍 Send the prescription ID. The ID is printed on the form your doctor gave you, under the QR code — for example: NR-K7M2-9QX4
bot.idBadFormat: ❌ That ID does not look right. A prescription ID looks like NR-XXXX-XXXX, for example: NR-K7M2-9QX4
bot.idNotFound: ❌ No prescription found for {id}. Check the ID and send it again, or contact your doctor.
bot.cancelledRx: ⚠️ Prescription {id} has been cancelled by the doctor. Please contact your doctor.
bot.notUnderstood: I did not understand 🤔 Send a prescription ID (e.g. NR-K7M2-9QX4) or tap 🔍 Find prescription.
bot.throttled: ⏳ Too many requests. Please try again in a minute.
bot.mineFound: 🧾 Found {n} prescriptions for you. Pick one:
bot.mineNone: No prescriptions are linked to your phone number. Try looking one up by ID — 🔍 Find prescription.
bot.noPhoneSaved: Your phone number is not saved. Please press /start.
bot.help: How does the NodiRetsept bot work? 1️⃣ Your doctor writes the prescription and gives you an ID and a QR code. 2️⃣ Tap 🔍 Find prescription. 3️⃣ Send the ID — for example NR-K7M2-9QX4. 4️⃣ The bot sends you the prescription as a PDF. You can also scan the QR code with your phone camera to open it directly. 🌐 Website: {url}
